notes: Identity assessment: canonical text title is Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate a claim from van Gastel_PsychMed_2013_AOQj; credited replication team Elisabeth Julie Vargo; SCORE RR ID 21487; OSF Project https://osf.io/697dv; SOURCE URL https://osf.io/download/yd9bg/. These identifiers and the cited van Gastel 2013 original title match the neutral reference/project. The full uploader-author list/date from the input is not independently printed in this report. This is a completed primary replication report containing results and Tables 1–3, not a preregistration or abstract. No PDF supplied. Empty input description/locators do not distinguish three explicitly reported distress outcomes. Candidate smoking rows: Table 1 negative distress B=.0063246857479, standardized Beta=.0054913499723, t=.1947514315708, Sig.=.8456167629028; Table 2 positive distress B=.0274998122173, standardized Beta=.0246228540727, t=.8742022994525, Sig.=.3821631203854; Table 3 depressive distress B=.0193037635725, standardized Beta=.0148543505843, t=.5285074658139, Sig.=.5972337804787. Each Sig. is paired with its own smoking test. Tables print B, Std. Error, standardized Beta, t and Sig., not requested Cohen's f^2. No metric conversion performed; no target selected by row order or numeric matching. Unassigned fields remain placeholders only.
